title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Court on How to Determine the Guilt of Personnel Engaged in Management in Joint-Stock Companies Controlled or Participated by State-Owned Capital Who Illegally Appropriate the Company's Property by Taking Advantage of Their Positions

articles.content_en:
Fa Shi [2001] No. 17
Chongqing Higher People's Court:
We have received your Request for Instructions on How to Characterize the Embezzlement of Company Property by Persons Engaged in Management in a Company Limited by Shares (Yu Gao Fa Ming Chuan [2000] No. 38). After our study, we reply as follows:
Persons engaged in management in a company limited by shares with state-owned capital holding or participating shares shall not be regarded as state functionaries, except those who are dispatched by state organs, state-owned companies, enterprises, or institutions to engage in public service. Where such persons, by taking advantage of their positions, illegally take possession of the property of the unit for themselves in a relatively large amount, the act shall be convicted and punished as the crime of embezzlement by taking advantage of duties in accordance with the provisions of Article 271, paragraph 1 of the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China.
It is so replied.
